import io

buffer = io.StringIO("line one\nline two")
with buffer as handle:
    first = handle.readline()
    print(repr(first))
print(buffer.closed)
try:
    buffer.read()
except ValueError as error:
    print("ValueError:", error)

True

name: example:generators-1
code:
def countdown(n):
    while n > 0:
        yield n
        n -= 1

g = countdown(2)
print(list(g))
print(list(g))
print(list(countdown(2)))

name: choice:c01-predict-default-list:true
code:
def add(item, bag=None):
    bag = [] if bag is None else bag
    bag.append(item)
    return bag

print(add("a"))
print(add("b"))
